evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows'; switches native Windows builds and CI from cl.exe to clang-cl across CMake configurations and GitHub Actions workflows.
rationale: Switches native Windows builds to clang-cl, eliminating MSVC-specific compiler bugs and yielding major build and codegen speedups. The author reports a 38% reduction in Windows CI build times (from 20m 35s to 12m 43s), closes compiler bug issues #31456 and #36153, and measures block connection throughput improvements of ~55–60% over MSVC codegen.
